result.summary: This surface of godbus/dbus v5.2.2 is a pure-Go D-Bus client: bus address discovery, EXTERNAL and ANONYMOUS authentication, wire encoding and decoding, and Unix, tcp and nonce-tcp transports. I checked the init functions (only transport registration and endianness detection), the exec of dbus-launch, the environment changes, credential passing and every network dial. All of it matches upstream behaviour and the library's purpose, with no hidden endpoints, encoded payloads or extra data collection.

findings.title: Session bus autolaunch runs dbus-launch from PATH
findings.detail: When no session bus address is found, getSessionBusPlatformAddress runs "dbus-launch" resolved via PATH and sets whatever environment variable name appears before '=' in its output. This is standard upstream godbus behaviour for D-Bus autolaunch, not deliberate misuse. It is noted because it runs an external binary.

findings.title: nonce-tcp sends noncefile contents to the bus
findings.detail: The nonce-tcp transport reads the file named by the bus address's noncefile key and writes its bytes to the TCP socket. This is what the D-Bus nonce-tcp spec requires. The address comes from the caller or the environment, so it is not hidden exfiltration.

capabilities.explanation: getSessionBusPlatformAddress runs the fixed command "dbus-launch" via exec.Command and parses the KEY=value line it prints, to autolaunch a session bus when no address can be found. This is the standard D-Bus autolaunch behaviour, reached only through the session-bus connect functions.

os.Setenv sets DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS (or the variable name dbus-launch printed) in the current process, caching the discovered session bus address. getSessionBusAddress in conn.go does the same after discovering /run/user/<uid>/bus. It changes only this process's environment.

The bus transports connect to the address taken from the environment or the defaults: Unix sockets via net.DialUnix in transport_unix.go (system bus at /var/run/dbus/system_bus_socket, session bus at /run/user/<uid>/bus), and tcp and nonce-tcp via net.Dial in transport_tcp.go and transport_nonce_tcp.go. These are the core purpose of a D-Bus client library. escape.go also uses net/url only to unescape address values, which is harmless parsing.

data_flows.what: D-Bus messages built by the application, plus any Unix file descriptors passed as SCM_RIGHTS
data_flows.to: D-Bus daemon over a Unix domain socket (system or session bus address)

data_flows.what: The process PID, UID and GID as SCM_CREDENTIALS, sent with the initial null byte for EXTERNAL authentication
data_flows.to: D-Bus daemon over a Unix socket

data_flows.what: The hex-encoded effective UID during the EXTERNAL auth handshake

data_flows.to: TCP host:port named in a tcp: bus address

data_flows.what: Contents of the noncefile named in the address (as the D-Bus spec requires), then D-Bus messages
data_flows.to: TCP host:port named in a nonce-tcp: bus address

data_flows.what: Runs the fixed dbus-launch command with no input and reads its output to get a session bus address
